parameters.content:
## Lamig technician schedules
Runs every 15 minutes. All the rules live in Supabase (`lamig.claim_schedule_emails`):

1. Gives a technician to any job for today or tomorrow that has none (for example after a day off).
2. From 6 PM (business_settings.schedule_send_hour), queues tomorrow's schedule for each technician with jobs.
3. When a job changes after a schedule went out (new booking, cancelled, reassigned), queues an updated schedule.

Each email is written, sent with Brevo, then marked sent or failed (2 retries). Status shows in the website admin Automation page.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ sender: {"name":"Lamig Aircon Cleaning","email":"roivincentsolar@gmail.com"}, to: [{ email: $json.to_email }], subject: $json.subject, htmlContent: $json.html }) }}

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Write the schedule').item.json.schedule_id, $json.error?.message ?? $json.error ?? 'Email could not be sent' ] }}
